purpose: Phase-1 data audit and archived-feature-recovery groundwork for a future rebuild-native wnba-elo-trend-lr-rebuild-v1 sibling model. Not a model-training run.
note_on_data_vintage: Every normalized row's observed_at_utc is this backfill run's real capture timestamp (2026-08-11), not a per-game historical vintage. SportsDataverse serves one current release per season, not dated historical snapshots, so this data supports 'team form as of today, ordered by real historical event_start_utc' feature construction, but NOT genuine prospective walk-forward replay where decision_time_utc is set inside the season -- doing that yields zero eligible prior games every time, verified directly in tests/rebuild/test_wnba_features.py's real-data test. This matches docs/model_audit/models/WNBA_ARCHIVED_BASELINES.md's pre-existing 'capture-time-only is not retrospective PIT evidence' finding; this audit independently reproduced the concrete mechanism.

player_box_2022_dash_value.severity: P2 -- blocks one season/table combination, does not affect games/team_box (which is what the recovered features.py/horizon_builder.py actually consume)
player_box_2022_dash_value.description: 2022 WNBA player_box normalization fails for the entire season with 'normalization error: invalid WNBA number: --'. Root cause traced directly: exactly one row (athlete Kianna Smith, a 2022 game) has plus_minus == '--' (ESPN's own placeholder for a not-applicable/unavailable stat) in the raw SportsDataverse release. normalize.py's _as_float() raises ValueError on any non-numeric string rather than treating '--' as null, and _team_box/_player_box normalize the whole season's frame as one unit, so one bad value blocks all 5307 rows of 2022 player_box.
player_box_2022_dash_value.scope_decision: Not fixed in this pass. normalize.py is shared, already-tested infrastructure outside this task's RECOVER scope (features.py/horizon_builder.py only); a fix belongs to whoever owns normalize.py's contract next, not silently patched as a side effect of feature-recovery work.
player_box_2022_dash_value.does_not_block: The recovered Four-Factors feature path (features.py/horizon_builder.py) does not consume player_box at all -- only games and team_box, both COMPLETE for 2022.

pbp_all_seasons_unresolved_identity.severity: P1 for anyone wanting WNBA play-by-play data specifically; does not affect this task's RECOVER scope
pbp_all_seasons_unresolved_identity.description: PBP normalization failed for all 4 backfilled seasons (2022-2025), every time with 'unresolved WNBA player identity for ESPN ID <N>' (ESPN IDs 695, 14 seen directly). Root cause traced directly: the raw PBP feed references athlete IDs (athlete_id_1) that have athlete_name_1 == null and never appear in any team_box/player_box/roster row for that season, so they were never registered in the IdentityRegistry. normalize.py's _pbp() normalizer's _existing_identity() call raises hard on the very first unresolvable ID, blocking the entire season's frame (93,166 rows for 2022 alone) rather than dropping just the unresolvable play.
pbp_all_seasons_unresolved_identity.scope_decision: Not fixed in this pass, same reasoning as above -- normalize.py is out of this task's RECOVER scope. Recorded as a real, currently-total gap: 0/4 seasons of WNBA pbp are usable via rebuild-data today.
pbp_all_seasons_unresolved_identity.does_not_block: The recovered Four-Factors feature path does not consume pbp.

empty_team_box_crash_in_archived_feature.severity: P2 -- found and fixed in this pass, part of the RECOVER port
empty_team_box_crash_in_archived_feature.description: The archived build_team_form_snapshot() (features.py) called eligible_prior_team_games() unconditionally, which raises ValueError on a fully empty (zero-row, zero-column) team_box or games frame -- the real shape WNBANormalizedStore.read_observations() returns when a season's table was never backfilled at all (not just zero matching rows). This would crash an entire horizon-builder run for one never-backfilled season instead of degrading to the same UNAVAILABLE/zero-sample result the function already returns for zero eligible rows.
empty_team_box_crash_in_archived_feature.fix: Added an explicit empty-frame guard in build_team_form_snapshot() (src/model_prediction/rebuild/wnba/features.py) that returns the same UNAVAILABLE/zero-sample shape directly when games or team_box is empty, before calling eligible_prior_team_games(). Covered by tests/rebuild/test_wnba_horizon_builder.py::TestMissingnessIsHonest::test_target_with_no_prior_team_history_is_recorded_not_dropped_silently.
empty_team_box_crash_in_archived_feature.found_via: Writing a real end-to-end test for the recovered horizon_builder.py against a season with a scheduled target game but zero backfilled team_box history.

sufficiency_for_training_next_phase.structural_caveat: All of the above is capture-time-only (single vintage per season, captured 2026-08-11), not per-game prospective observation. This is sufficient to build historically-ordered rolling-form features for research/backtest purposes (event_start_utc ordering is real, immutable historical fact), but is NOT sufficient, by itself, to claim genuine walk-forward point-in-time evidence the way docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's validation contract requires for production qualification -- matches the pre-existing, already-documented blocker in WNBA_ARCHIVED_BASELINES.md, independently reproduced here.
